input_fields.name: output_paths
input_fields.description: Run output paths with one declared role and expected format each.

input_fields.name: run_ownership
input_fields.description: Run ID, owned root, baseline/evidence exclusions, and write context.

input_fields.name: overwrite_policy
input_fields.description: Whether an existing path may be replaced; default is reject.

result_fields.name: path_validation
result_fields.description: Canonical paths, collisions, ownership, and writable-parent checks.

result_fields.name: accepted_paths
result_fields.description: Only paths safe for a later write operation.

procedure: Canonicalize each path and associate it with one role and run-owned root.
Check baseline/evidence collisions, parents, existing files, and explicit overwrite policy.
Return path_validation and accepted_paths; preserve rejected paths and reasons.
Do not create directories, overwrite files, or remove artifacts.
rejection_rules: Reject outside-root paths, role collisions, existing files without permission, traversal/reparse ambiguity, or unowned parents.
Do not auto-create a parent or substitute a different path.
Do not claim later save/export success.
